item.title: Kayden Mingo’s late basket helps Penn State edge Minnesota, end 8-game skid
item.description: UNIVERSITY PARK — Freddie Dilione V had 25 points, and Kayden Mingo scored with one second left as Penn State snapped an eight-game losing streak by extending Minnesota’s skid to seven with a 77-75 victory Sunday.

item.title: Lightning’s historic 4-goal comeback stuns Bruins in NHL Stadium Series
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. — Nikita Kucherov scored the tying goal in the third period, Jake Guentzel scored the only goal in the shootout, and the Tampa Bay Lightning rallied from a four-goal deficit to beat the Boston Bruins, 6-5, in front of 64,617 fans at an NHL Stadium Series game at Raymond James Stadium.
